record.paper_title: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
record.original_question: Let M = M(X,g)^Γ be an equivariant map Lie algebra, formed from an affine scheme X, a Lie algebra g, and a compatible Γ-action, and let V be an M-module. Determine the homology groups H∗(M,V), including the structural consequences for the abelianization H0(M,Mad) = M / [M,M] of the adjoint module and for identifying perfect equivariant map algebras.

evidence.quote: The action of Γ on X induces an action on the coordinate ring A of X. Then M = (a ⊗ A)Γ , the fixed points of the diagonal action of Γ on a ⊗ A.

A related problem is to determine the homology groups H∗ (M, V ). Some re- sults on H0 (M, Mad ) = M/[M, M] are contained in [NSS12] and [NS], see for example Lemmas 6.1 and 6.10 of [NS] describing classes of perfect equivariant map

algebras. The interest in perfect equivariant map algebras comes from Theorem 3.2 which indicates that these algebras have a simpler representation theory. A second reason is that perfect Lie algebras have universal central extensions, as discussed in Section 4.3.3 below.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma$ be a group acting on an affine scheme $X$ (equivalently, acting on its coordinate ring $A = \mathcal{O}(X)$) and on a Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ over a field $k$, with both actions compatible (the $\Gamma$-action on $\mathfrak{g}$ is by Lie algebra automorphisms, and the $\Gamma$-action on $A$ is by algebra automorphisms). Form the diagonal $\Gamma$-action on $\mathfrak{g} \otimes_k A$ and let
$$M = M(X,\mathfrak{g})^\Gamma = (\mathfrak{g} \otimes_k A)^\Gamma$$
be the corresponding equivariant map Lie algebra (the fixed-point Lie subalgebra). Let $V$ be an $M$-module.

(a) Compute the Lie algebra homology groups $H_*(M, V)$ in terms of the data $(X, \mathfrak{g}, \Gamma, V)$.

(b) In particular, determine the abelianization
$$H_0(M, M_{\mathrm{ad}}) = M / [M,M],$$
where $M_{\mathrm{ad}}$ denotes $M$ as a module over itself via the adjoint action, and characterize precisely those triples $(X, \mathfrak{g}, \Gamma)$ for which $M$ is perfect, i.e.\ $M = [M,M]$.
artifact.status_search_result: The general computation of Lie algebra homology $H_*(M,V)$ for equivariant map algebras appears to remain open. Partial results are known: classes of perfect equivariant map algebras (i.e., descriptions of $H_0(M, M_{\mathrm{ad}}) = M/[M,M]$) have been obtained by Neher–Savage and Neher–Savage–Senesi, but a full computation of higher homology in this generality has not been carried out.

status_evidence.title: Neher–Savage: A survey of equivariant map algebras with open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lemmas describing classes of perfect equivariant map algebras give partial results on H_0(M, M_ad) = M/[M,M]; the general computation of H_*(M,V) is posed as a related problem.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results on the abelianization are recorded; higher homology is listed as a problem.
